chapters.title: First customer
chapters.body: Accept a small job, inspect the car and identify the fault before ordering parts.

chapters.title: Make it profitable
chapters.body: Parts, wages and rent all matter. Check the ledger before accepting a job with a tight budget.

chapters.title: Build your crew
chapters.body: Hire a mechanic to free your own time. Match job complexity to staff skill.

chapters.title: Earn trust
chapters.body: Finish on time, pass quality control and avoid promising work you cannot deliver.

chapters.title: Expand the workshop
chapters.body: Invest in lifts, diagnostics and specialist equipment to unlock higher-value projects.
